2.211.8
MapColorScale.LabelFormat
Applies to RDL 2010/01 and RDL 2016/01
The MapColorScale.LabelFormat element specifies the label format for a MapColorScale. This
element is optional. If the MapColorScale.LabelFormat element is present, its value MUST be a
String ([XMLSCHEMA2/2] section 3.2.1) or an expression that evaluates to a String. If this element is
not present, its value is interpreted as #,##0.##.
The following is the parent element of the MapColorScale.LabelFormat element.
Parent elements
MapColorScale
The following is the XML Schema definition of the MapColorScale.LabelFormat element.
 <xsd:element name="LabelFormat" type="xsd:string" minOccurs="0" />
